'''2020 TMW Round of 16 Steve Baroni DS Agents Of Black Sun (2)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Round of 16).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Baroni]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Round of 16
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open AOBS Baroni DS 2020 Texas.txt |Download]]
